Comparison

Canva AI vs Figma AI

A side-by-side look at Canva AI and Figma AI, using the details in each tool profile.

Quick take

Choose Canva AI when your priority is: non-designers producing large volumes of on-brand marketing and social content. Choose Figma AI when your priority is: professional UI design where AI accelerates rather than replaces the designer.

CriteriaCanva AIFigma AI
CategoryAI Design ToolsAI Design Tools

Platforms
  • Web, Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Chrome extension, Figma plugin, Microsoft Office add-ins
  • Web, Windows, macOS, iOS, Android (view/present)

Key features
  • Magic Design generating full designs from a prompt or uploaded image
  • Magic Write AI copywriting
  • Magic Eraser and Magic Edit for object removal and replacement
  • Background Remover
  • Magic Switch reformatting a design across formats and translating it
  • Magic Animate

  • Figma Make turning designs or prompts into working, interactive prototypes with code

Advantages
  • By far the lowest barrier to producing decent design output - no skill required and enormous template library
  • Magic Switch reformatting and translating a design in one action is a genuine time-saver for multi-market marketing
  • Brand Hub gives real governance over non-designer output
  • excellent value at $15/mo for the breadth.
  • Figma is the industry standard for UI design and the AI sits inside that workflow rather than beside it
  • the MCP server giving coding agents real design context is strategically significant and genuinely useful
  • Figma Make producing working coded prototypes closes the design-to-code gap
  • visual search across large files solves a real pain.
Limitations
  • Output is recognisably 'Canva' - templates are so widely used that brand distinctiveness suffers
  • AI credit limits are opaque and frustrating
  • not a professional design tool (no precise typography or print production control)
  • RTL and Arabic typography handling still lags
  • AI features are noticeably less mature than the core product and less capable than dedicated generators
  • the 2025 seat-type restructure made pricing more complex and, for many teams, more expensive
  • credit limits on Figma Make are restrictive
  • Adobe acquisition attempt and subsequent independence created roadmap uncertainty

Pricing notes

Canva AI

Canva Free $0 with limited AI credits (historically ~50 lifetime Magic Write uses and limited image generations). Canva Pro around $15/mo or $120/yr for one person, with substantially more AI credits, Brand Kit, Magic Resize and premium content. Canva Teams around $10/user/mo billed annually (minimum seats apply) with shared brand controls and approval workflows. Canva Enterprise custom, annual, with SSO, advanced brand controls and admin management. Free for eligible schools and registered non-profits.

Figma AI

Starter free for up to 3 files and 3 pages, with limited AI. Professional around $16/full seat/mo billed annually ($20 monthly); Figma restructured to seat types (Collab, Dev, Full) in 2025, with Dev seats around $12 and Collab seats around $5 annually. Organization around $45/full seat/mo annually with design systems analytics and SSO. Enterprise around $75/full seat/mo annually. Figma Make and AI features have their own credit allowances by tier, with full seats getting the largest allowance.

Prices change often. Confirm on the official pricing pages: Canva AI ↗ · Figma AI ↗

Frequently asked questions

What is the main difference between Canva AI and Figma AI?

Canva AI: AI layer across Canva's design platform - Magic Studio. Figma AI: AI capabilities across Figma's professional design platform - generating first drafts, renaming layers, rewriting copy, searching designs visually, and in Figma Make, generating working prototypes and code from a prompt.

When should I choose Canva AI over Figma AI?

Canva AI is listed as best for: non-designers producing large volumes of on-brand marketing and social content. Figma AI is listed as best for: professional UI design where AI accelerates rather than replaces the designer.

Do Canva AI and Figma AI have a free plan?

Canva AI: Yes. Figma AI: Yes. Check each official pricing page, as plans change.
